sub_graphs.title: Phase0 P2P: Gossip Message Validation Pipeline
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation pipeline for gossip messages including beacon blocks, attestations, and slashing messages with ACCEPT/REJECT/IGNORE outcomes

nodes.label: Gossip Message Received
nodes.description: A compressed gossip message has been received from a peer on a subscribed topic

nodes.label: Decompress Snappy Payload
nodes.description: Decompress snappy block compression, verify uncompressed size <= 10 MiB

nodes.label: Compute Message ID
nodes.description: Compute 20-byte SHA256 hash with MESSAGE_DOMAIN_VALID_SNAPPY or MESSAGE_DOMAIN_INVALID_SNAPPY prefix

nodes.label: Validate Beacon Block
nodes.description: Check block is not from future slot, has valid proposer signature, parent exists, and proposer matches expected shuffling

nodes.label: Validate Attestation
nodes.description: Verify committee index validity, epoch matching, single participating validator, and valid signature

nodes.label: Validate Aggregate and Proof
nodes.description: Verify committee index, epoch, aggregation bit count, aggregator selection proof, and both aggregator and attestation signatures

nodes.label: Message Accepted
nodes.description: Message passed all validation checks and is forwarded to mesh peers

nodes.label: Message Rejected
nodes.description: Message failed validation; sender peer is penalized via scoring

nodes.label: Message Ignored
nodes.description: Message is duplicate or future-dated; silently discarded without peer penalty

external_entities.name: Network Peer
external_entities.description: Remote peer in the GossipSub mesh sending messages on subscribed topics

sub_graphs.title: Phase0 P2P: Request/Response Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Models the request/response domain including Status exchange, block syncing, and peer liveness protocols

nodes.label: Peer Connection Established
nodes.description: TCP/QUIC connection established with a remote peer

nodes.label: Exchange Status Messages
nodes.description: Exchange fork digest, finalized checkpoint, and head block information on connection

nodes.label: Check Fork Digest Compatibility
nodes.description: Compare local and remote fork digests; disconnect if mismatched

nodes.label: Peer Compatible
nodes.description: Peer has matching fork digest and is suitable for continued interaction

nodes.label: Peer Disconnected
nodes.description: Peer disconnected due to fork digest mismatch or protocol violation

nodes.label: Request Blocks by Range
nodes.description: Request blocks in slot range [start_slot, start_slot + count), max 1024 blocks

nodes.label: Request Blocks by Root
nodes.description: Query specific blocks by root hash, max 1024 per request

nodes.label: Response Chunks Received
nodes.description: Zero or more response chunks received, each with single-byte result code (0=success, 1=invalid, 2=server error, 3=unavailable)

nodes.label: Ping Peer
nodes.description: Exchange sequence numbers to maintain peer liveness and detect metadata changes

external_entities.name: Remote Beacon Node
external_entities.description: Remote beacon node peer discovered via discv5 or connected via libp2p

sub_graphs.title: Phase0 P2P: Peer Discovery and Subnet Management
sub_graphs.description: Models discv5-based peer discovery, ENR management, and deterministic attestation subnet subscription

nodes.label: Node Bootstrapping
nodes.description: Node starting up and initiating peer discovery via discv5 protocol

nodes.label: Publish ENR Record
nodes.description: Publish Ethereum Node Record with secp256k1 key, IP addresses, ports, eth2 fork info, and attnets bitfield

nodes.label: Compute Persistent Subnet Assignments
nodes.description: Deterministically compute 2 persistent subnet subscriptions from node ID, valid for EPOCHS_PER_SUBNET_SUBSCRIPTION (256 epochs ~27 hours)

nodes.label: Subscribed to Attestation Subnets
nodes.description: Node is subscribed to 2 persistent subnets out of 64 total attestation subnets

nodes.label: Discover Peers via discv5
nodes.description: Find peers with matching fork parameters using eth2 ENR field (fork digest, next fork version, next fork epoch)

nodes.label: Peer Pool Populated
nodes.description: Sufficient peers discovered with target mesh size D=8 (range 6-12)

sub_graphs.title: Phase0 P2P: Peer Scoring and Message Size Limits
sub_graphs.description: Models security boundaries including peer scoring, message size validation, clock disparity tolerance, and rate limiting

nodes.label: Oversized Message Detected
nodes.description: Received message exceeds MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE (10 MiB) after decompression

nodes.label: Update Peer Score
nodes.description: Adjust peer reputation score based on message validity (ACCEPT/REJECT/IGNORE outcomes)

nodes.label: Peer Below Score Threshold
nodes.description: Peer score has dropped below acceptable threshold due to repeated invalid messages

nodes.label: Disconnect Misbehaving Peer
nodes.description: Disconnect and potentially ban peer with persistently low score

nodes.label: Check Clock Disparity
nodes.description: Verify message timestamps are within MAXIMUM_GOSSIP_CLOCK_DISPARITY (500ms) tolerance

nodes.label: Validate Length Prefix
nodes.description: Verify SSZ-snappy length prefix is minimally encoded and <= 10 bytes

external_entities.name: Network Peer
external_entities.description: Remote peer that may send malformed, oversized, or malicious messages

ambiguities.text: Clients track peer reputation, potentially descoring or disconnecting misbehaving peers - the exact scoring thresholds and penalties are not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations define their own scoring parameters within the GossipSub v1.1 framework. Specific thresholds are implementation-dependent.

ambiguities.text: Rate limiting occurs between response chunks but the specific rate limits and backpressure mechanisms are not detailed.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations apply per-protocol rate limits with MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS=2 as the primary concurrency control.

ambiguities.text: Servers must maintain block records for approximately 5 months - the exact retention period and what 'approximately' means is ambiguous.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the retention period corresponds to the weak subjectivity period, approximately MIN_VALIDATOR_WITHDRAWABILITY_DELAY + CHURN_LIMIT_QUOTIENT epochs.

implicit_assumptions.description: Peer clocks are synchronized within MAXIMUM_GOSSIP_CLOCK_DISPARITY (500ms) via NTP or similar.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Messages may be incorrectly rejected as future-dated or accepted when they should be ignored, causing inconsistent gossip propagation.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot create enough Sybil peers to dominate the GossipSub mesh (target D=8 peers).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Eclipse attack: attacker controls all mesh peers and can censor or delay messages, potentially causing the node to fall out of sync.

implicit_assumptions.description: The snappy decompression library correctly enforces the 10 MiB uncompressed size limit without memory exhaustion during decompression.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Decompression bomb: malicious compressed payload could consume excessive memory before size check triggers, causing OOM denial of service.

implicit_assumptions.description: Network latency between peers is generally low enough for attestations to propagate within ATTESTATION_PROPAGATION_SLOT_RANGE (32 slots).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attestations may expire before reaching all relevant peers, reducing effective participation and potentially affecting finality.
